events.what: Chang and Sun prove Harborth's conjecture for all 4-regular planar graphs (hence all planar graphs of maximum degree at most 4)
'On the Harborth Conjecture. Part I' proves the non-degenerate-quadrilateral case of Kleber's integer-coordinate strengthening
Förster, Kobourov, Miller, Zink give polynomial-grid integer-edge-length drawings of trees and cacti (Kleber-type, already-known class)

judgement.doubts: The Chang–Sun event is dated only to the year 2024, so the record cannot place it relative to 26 January 2024; it is kept as post-snapshot because it appears in the Graph Drawing 2024 proceedings, but a first public preprint month would confirm this. The two later items change the question (Kleber's integer-coordinate strengthening) and cannot set the status.

corrections.why: other: kept. Chang–Sun settle a restriction (4-regular planar graphs) in a refereed LIPIcs GD 2024 paper, so scope case → partial. Doubt: event.date is year-only '2024', so it cannot be placed after 26 January 2024 from the record alone (see the 2026-09-23 correction). A GD 2024 proceedings paper is very probably post-snapshot, but this is unconfirmed.
